decisions: Catalog-owned ProbeInputBinding locates caption/reference beneath project root; requests carry no paths.
Worker emits facts only; host builds ProbeMeasurement with catalog policy (policy logic stays out of the isolated worker).
systemd-run summary is parsed from the trailing block; worker stderr is redirected to /dev/null after start.
System interpreter/systemd-run are hashed at their resolved targets in the control identity; tool executables are hashed with O_NOFOLLOW.
limitations: Recipes (Task 4) are not implemented; real worker refuses every recipe as RECIPE_UNAVAILABLE.
Kernel integration cases require a systemd user manager with delegated cpu/memory/pids; CI without it will fail these cases rather than skip.
Failure-path ResourceEvidence is not yet persisted; Task 5 owns storage of failed/ambiguous executions.
Root authority equality (MasterAuthorityRepository) must precede snapshot_probe_inputs; enforced in Task 5.
